sections.mainTip:
**Main Tip: Turn a Quiet Tuesday Into a Full House With Smart Text-Back Campaigns**

A single well-timed text can do more for your slow nights than a week of social media posts.

- Capture opt-ins at checkout or on receipts, then let AI segment guests by visit frequency, order type, and last visit date.
- Send a personalized Tuesday-specific offer within 48 hours of a visit, while your restaurant is still fresh in their mind.
- Keep messages short and direct: a real offer, a real deadline, a real reason to come back this week.
- According to [Klaviyo](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/sms-marketing-benchmarks), SMS open rates average around 98%, making text the highest-attention channel you have.
- Use AI to auto-pause messages for guests who book, so no one feels spammed after they say yes.
- Track redemption by day-part to refine your Tuesday offer over time without guesswork.
sections.newsRoundup:
**This Week in AI**

**Charleston County Offers Free AI Tool Access to 250 Small Businesses**
Palmetto Goodwill is sponsoring two years of GoodBiz.AI access for local certified small businesses at no cost.
- Why it matters: County-sponsored AI access is a replicable model other local markets should watch closely.

**Rancho Mirage Chamber Makes AI the Focus of Its Annual Marketing Summit**
Experts highlighted AI for customer response, data analysis, and operations while stressing human judgment remains essential.
- Why it matters: The "human plus AI" message from local chambers is exactly what small business owners need to hear.

**AI Adoption Is Rising Among SMBs, but Proven ROI Stays Elusive**
77% of small businesses use AI regularly, yet only 41% report actual revenue increases per a 34,000-business study.
- Why it matters: Starting small, tracking results, and scaling what works beats buying tools and hoping for the best.

sections.spotlight:
**Industry Spotlight: Restaurants & Bars**

The Anchor Grille was losing reservations every Friday night. Calls went unanswered during the dinner rush, and their website sat silent after midnight.

After deploying JB.AI's Bundle, everything shifted.

Their AI Voice Bot now answers every incoming call, takes reservations, and recites daily specials without missing a beat. The AI Chatbot handles the website simultaneously, fielding hours, menu questions, and booking requests around the clock.

Within 60 days, The Anchor Grille saw a 34 percent increase in confirmed reservations, missed calls dropped from roughly 80 per week to near zero, and front-of-house staff reclaimed time to focus on guests already at the table.

Fewer empty seats. Happier staff. A fuller house, seven nights a week.
